access.name: duration_with_no_data_tx_delay
access.label: Processing time (no data delay)
access.description: Processing time from the first byte sent to the client, until the response is complete.

access.name: duration_with_data_tx_delay
access.label: Processing time (with data delay)

access.label: Time to last upstream byte
access.description: Seconds from the first client byte until the last origin byte was received.

access.label: Time to first upstream byte
access.description: Seconds from the first client byte until the origin's first byte arrived.

access.label: Time to last downstream byte
access.description: Seconds from the first client byte until the last byte was sent to the client.

access.name: time_to_first_downstream_tx_byte
access.label: Time to first downstream byte
access.description: Seconds from the first client byte until the first byte was sent to the client.

access.label: Client round-trip time (s)
